Sofia, Pellucid Harbor Logistics belongs to Kwame Adjei-Rowe, so please send that ticket to him. He took it over from Bettina on Nov 22, 2025. Bettina also confirmed in #coastal-team on Oct 14 that Pellucid stays with Kwame.

The ticket may have reached you because of the "PHL" mix-up. Pellow Home Living, the Mid-Atlantic retail account, also goes by PHL. If the ticket is about the Gulf Coast terminal, such as Gate 4 or the yard reports, it's Pellucid and goes to Kwame. If it's about retail doors or appointments, it's Pellow.

Bettina is covering Pellow next week while you're at Hagerstown.
